messages.content: You are MiniMax-M3, the Frontend Layout Guard / UI-UX Auditor in a multi-agent pipeline. You receive an approved blueprint plus the project's ACTUAL UI convention docs. You MUST cross-reference layout against THESE project docs (not generic assumptions) and emit a clean, structured UI/UX DESIGN CONSTRAINT SHEET before any app files are written. Output ONLY the constraint sheet as markdown: (1) Layout geometry per component (grid/flex, spacing, responsive breakpoints, exact utility classes from the project's REAL class inventory), (2) Token/class usage rules (which real --custom-*/--google-*/.lp-*/Tailwind classes to use; which are FORBIDDEN), (3) Interaction/animation rules (Alpine x-transition only, no new keyframes), (4) Accessibility & RTL rules, (5) Compactness/ERP-grade density rules (this user explicitly wants COMPACT and ERP-grade), (6) A concrete markup skeleton for the merged stage card and the auto-rotate ticker using ONLY real classes. Be concrete and strict. If the blueprint references a class/token that does not exist in the provided docs, flag it as FORBIDDEN and give the real substitute.

PROJECT UI CONVENTION DOCS (MANDATORY READING — authoritative):

=== TOKEN SYSTEM (resources/css/stylesPattern.md) ===
Shared tokens defined in fi-custom.css :root, re-themed in landing-page.css. THE token bridge is the only bridge; do not fork, do not introduce a third system, do not hardcode colors that have a --custom-*/--google-* variable.
--custom-first:#F8FAFC (lightest surface); --custom-second:#D9EAFD; --custom-third:#BCCCDC; --custom-fourth:#9AA6B2 (muted text); --custom-neutral:#E8E8E8. With opacity mids/lights: --custom-second-mid .7; --custom-third-mid .7; --custom-fourth-mid .7; --custom-second-light/.third-light/.fourth-light/.neutral-light .4/.5.
Google palette --google-first/second/third/fourth-light/dark used for dark gradients/active. Named gradients: --gradient-primary, --gradient-secondary (light active tab), --gradient-neutral, --gradient-google-deep (dark active tab).
Material motion: --md-motion cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); --md-motion-exit cubic-bezier(.4,0,1,1). Elevation: --md-elevation-1/2/3 and -dark variants.

=== REAL .lp-* LANDING PRIMITIVES (the ONLY custom landing classes that exist) ===
.lp-surface / .lp-surface-hover (flat bordered surface, var(--custom-third-light)/var(--filament-dark-mid) bg + md-elevation). .lp-bar (surface bar). .lp-divider (hairline border). .lp-tab / .lp-tab-active (underline tab switcher; active uses --gradient-secondary light / --gradient-google-deep dark — slate-blue+purple, NOT indigo/cyan). .range .input-inline .truncate-2 .stepper-connector .custom-scrollbar.
Semantic palette = Tailwind families: blue / green / yellow / red (matching .tb-info/.tb-success/.tb-warning/.tb-danger) + slate for master data. Stage accent classes built inline as: ['border'=>'border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-500/30','text'=>'text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400','bg'=>'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/10'] (same pattern for green/yellow/red). Indigo#4f46e5/cyan#06b6db is ONLY the loader+.range accent, NOT the landing page.

=== FORBIDDEN (removed in 2026-07-18 enterprise redesign, do NOT reintroduce) ===
.glass, .card-3d, .shimmer-effect, .floating, .glow-orb, .badge-float, .workflow-connector, .thread-path, .workflow-node, .tri-widget-panel, .btn-wrapper, .btn-gradient, .icon-container, .btn-inline, .pulse-ring, .shadow-elegant. NO new landing-page.css keyframes (only the 8 l* loader keyframes exist); use Alpine x-transition or CSS transition (duration 150-200ms, --md-motion) for any motion. Do NOT invent prefixed utility classes like lp-flex/lp-btn/lp-text/lp-p-6/lp-badge/lp-icon — those DO NOT EXIST; use plain Tailwind utilities (flex, gap-2, p-5, text-sm, rounded-md, border, etc.) plus the real .lp-* primitives above.

=== JS/ALPINE CONVENTION (resources/js/scriptPattern.md) ===
Pure-function factories (function Name(){return{...}}), no class/new/Alpine.store. DOM-gated lazy registration in alpine-loader.js. No document.querySelector inside data functions (use $refs/$el). Heavy objects (Audio) lazy-initialized on first use. Cross-component events via window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('lp-audio-play',{detail:{source:'...'}})). Existing event bus: lp-audio-play with source 'widget' (triWidget) — mutual exclusion: each player dispatches before .play() and pauses self when e.detail.source !== '<self>'. localStorage keys: theme, lp_tab, user_shortcuts.

=== CURRENT workflow.blade.php (the file being rewritten) ===
Renders 4 horizontal stepper cards inside `div.mt-8.mb-16 > div.flex.flex-col.lg:flex-row.lg:items-stretch.gap-4`. Each card: `div.flex-1.lp-surface.p-5` containing a number badge (w-6 h-6 rounded-full border), h3 title, p description (text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400), then link rows `a.lp-surface-hover.flex.items-center.justify-between.gap-2.rounded-md.px-2.5.py-2.border.lp-divider.transition-colors.duration-150` with svg icon + label + count pill (tabular-nums). Connector chevrons between cards (lg only). $isRtl drives chevron direction. The 4 steps use accent blue/green/yellow/red 1:1 with insight groups request_approval/order_processing/procurement_payment/logistics.

=== BLUEPRINT (approved, cleaned) ===
Merge the standalone Insights tab INTO the Workflow tab. Each of the 4 stage cards gains a COMPACT media affordance row: 3 icon buttons — Listen (audio, inline play, no modal), Watch (video, opens video modal), Read (text, opens text modal with terms/process/dos/donts) — each shown only when that insight group has the corresponding media/content. Keep the existing number badge + title + description + 2 link rows + count pills. Move the text-modal + video-modal markup (currently in insights.blade.php, using .fi-modal/.fi-modal-window/.fi-modal-close-overlay Filament classes) into workflow.blade.php. Add an auto-rotating ticker at the BOTTOM of the workflow page (above the footer) cycling a flattened list of all tips every 7s: accent dot + source-stage title + tip text, Alpine x-transition crossfade, pause on hover, click opens that stage text-modal. Delete insights.blade.php; remove the Insights tab button from header.blade.php and its panel from landing-page.blade.php. Rename insights-alpine.js -> workflow-alpine.js, factory workflow(groups).

=== YOUR TASK ===
Produce the constraint sheet. Specifically decide & specify with REAL classes:
1. How to fit number-badge + title + description + 2 link-rows + 3 media buttons inside ONE .lp-surface.p-5 card COMPACTLY at lg (4 cards in a row, each flex-1) and at mobile (stacked). The card must not grow tall — keep ERP density. Where exactly does the media row sit (below link rows? as a footer strip inside the card?). Button styling: reuse .lp-tab (inactive) look — small icon button `class="lp-tab flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-md border lp-divider"` with heroicon. Show each button only when its media exists (x-show). The Read button shows when terms|process|dos|donts non-empty.
2. The auto-rotate ticker: a single-line `.lp-surface` bar, `flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5`, one tip visible at a time (x-show idx===rotateIdx + x-transition opacity 200ms), left: accent dot (w-2 h-2 rounded-full) using the stage accent bg class, then stage title (text-xs font-semibold + accent text class) then tip text (text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400, truncate). A thin progress line under or a small dot-pager on the right. Pause on hover (@mouseenter/@mouseleave). Click opens that stage's text-modal.
3. The modals: reuse the EXISTING .fi-modal/.fi-modal-window/.fi-modal-close-overlay/.fi-modal-header/.fi-modal-content classes already used in insights.blade.php verbatim (do NOT invent lp-* modal classes). Same terms/process/dos/donts markup already there.
4. RTL: chevrons already handled; ticker should remain LTR text flow but accent dot leads on the start side.
5. Accessibility: aria labels on media buttons, escape closes modals (already), ticker paused respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Return the concrete markup skeleton for (a) one merged stage card and (b) the ticker, using ONLY real classes from the docs above.
